title: One hand
idea: The play hole is cut at the notch's own angle, its two sides parallel to the notch's two diagonals, so tail and triangle look cut by one hand, and it is as large as the bookmark can hold. That leaves room for a full-height pause in an even dark ring, and one module sets every wall, bar and gap, so the pause survives down to 32 px.
built: Same bookmark (43.5 dp wide, top at 27.1, reach 32.6 dp). The play's sides slope at the notch's 11 in 17 (32.9 degrees from level, 65.8 at the tip), so it is 44.6 dp tall and 34.5 deep, corners at the shoulder radius. One module, 4.1 dp (9.4% of the bookmark's width), sets the paper band over the notch, which runs parallel to it, the top wall, both pause bars, the gap between them and the dark ring round them. The left wall, 6.8 dp, is the one measure off the module, chosen so the drawn tip sits 6.5 dp from the right edge and the play is optically centred. The bars come out at 4.1 x 14.6 dp, about 1 to 3.5, the proportion of a standard pause sign. The left bar is a module from the flat side and the right bar's corners a module from the slanted sides, so the ring is even on all three sides and the pause sits in the deep part of the play, 1.9 dp left of the incircle centre.
small: The module is 3 px on the 48 px cut and 2 px on the 32, so both keep the pause. 48 px: bookmark 32 x 40 px, a 33 px play and 3 x 9 px bars, with the notch and the play's sides at 2:3 so they stay parallel on the pixel grid. 32 px: bookmark 22 x 27 px, a 23 px play and 2 x 6 px bars. Every bar sits on whole pixels. To make room, these two bookmarks fill about two thirds of the tile, against the master's 60%. 16 px drops the pause, since a 1 px module blurs into one grey patch, and shares n1's 4 x 7 px stepped play. Glyph 24: bookmark 16 x 20 px with a 15 px play hole and 2 px walls; no pause, as a 2 px pause does not fit.
risks: The hole is so large that the bookmark becomes a frame, and at a glance the play can register before the bookmark; that also puts it closest of the three to Google Play Books. The walls are 4.1 dp, under 3 px on a 1x home screen, so the frame looks light beside solid icons. The small cuts are drawn larger in their tiles than the master, so in the toolbar the icon looks a size up from the launcher's proportions.
